freeze_semantics: Content-hash freeze of the goose adapter's output over the conformance-scenario corpus at harness 1.28.0 (goose writes sessions.db schema_version 8 at this release). verify.py re-runs preprocess+DSL on each input (cwd = this dir, input paths relative) and asserts trace_count, per-trace content_hash, and unmapped_path_count. content_hash folds provenance.source_path, so inputs MUST stay at inputs/<name>.db. NOTE: the DSL adapter_pin declares schema-v7+v11, but its schema dispatch also parses this v8 corpus (the preprocessor branches on schema_version and v8 falls in the pre-v11 shape); recorded as an observed-compatible schema, not a claimed-supported one. annotated_cells_fired is the structural fired-cell set (drift self-test asserts it equals the goose CELL_SIGNALS extractor exactly). Second goose rung, older than the 1.33.1 anchor; the pair is goose's first release-delta baseline.
